title: Flame Potions
description: Adds fully functional Potions of Flame, Splash Potions, Lingering Potions, and Tipped Arrows of Flame to Minecraft
body:
🔥 **Flame Potions** adds a complete set of fire-based potions and tipped arrows to Minecraft, filling a surprisingly absent gap in vanilla's brewing system. Brew Potions of Flame from a Fire Charge and Awkward Potion, then craft Splash Potions, Lingering Potions, and Tipped Arrows of Flame — all with unique behaviors that make fire a viable combat and utility strategy.

<details>
<summary>Features</summary>

**Potions of Flame**

- Potion of Flame — Sets the target on fire for 5 seconds
- Potion of Flame (Extended) — Sets the target on fire for 10 seconds
- Potion of Flame II — Sets the target on fire for 8 seconds with enhanced fire damage
- All three variants available as drinkable, splash, and lingering potions

**Splash Potions of Flame**

- Ignites entities in the blast radius — including the thrower
- Ignites nearby blocks in a configurable radius (0–3 blocks)
- Flame II splash potions cover more area than Flame I

**Lingering Potions of Flame**

- Creates an area effect cloud that ignites players/mobs walking through it
- Extended and Flame II variants have larger, longer-lasting clouds (scales with your splash radius setting)

**Tipped Arrows of Flame**

- Arrow of Flame — Sets targets on fire for 5 seconds, the same as using a regular arrow with a flame bow
- Arrow of Flame (Extended) — Sets targets on fire for 10 seconds
- Arrow of Flame II — Sets targets on fire for 8 seconds with enhanced fire damage
- Arrows fly with visible flames, just like arrows from a Flame-enchanted bow
- Custom arrow tip texture for easy inventory identification

</details>


<details>
<summary>Advancements</summary>

- A dedicated "Playing with Fire" advancement tab with 4 unlockable advancements to guide players through the mod's features

</details>


<details>
<summary>Configuration</summary>

Adjust settings via Mod Menu (requires YACL):

**Splash Potion Flame Area**
- (0–3) — also scales lingering potion cloud size
- This is where you decide how big of an area the splash potion will splash.

**Water Interaction**
- (Pause or Remove)
- You can decide if the Flame effect will be put out with water, or just stop burning until the player/mob gets out of the water.

**Flame Bow Bonus**
- (On or Off)
- Fire a Flame tipped arrow from a Flame-enchanted bow or crossbow to get a double-duration bonus for Flame bow + Flame arrow combinations. Works with any weapon that has the Flame enchantment — including modded weapons.

</details>


<details>
<summary>Compatibility</summary>

- Built on vanilla item types — Potions of Flame are real potions, Tipped Arrows of Flame are real tipped arrows
- Fletcher villagers offer Tipped Arrows of Flame as one of their possible tipped arrow trades
- Server and client compatible

</details>



### Requirements

- Fabric Loader
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
- [YetAnotherConfigLib (YACL)](https://modrinth.com/mod/yacl) (for in-game config screen)
- [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) (for accessing config screen)
